impact.attacker_capability: Cause the recorded sanitizer-detected kernel panic through the mount path when the requisite writable union/umapfs setup is available; broader exploitability and exact prerequisites are not established.
impact.security_effect: Kernel denial of service in the UBSan-instrumented execution.

causal_trace.summary: A non-read-only union mount performs a probe of whether its upper layer supports whiteout operations.
Before the fix, union_mount supplied a NULL struct componentname to VOP_WHITEOUT even though the receiving filesystem may require a valid componentname.
VOP_WHITEOUT dispatch reaches umap_bypass, where UBSan reports member access within a NULL struct componentname at umap_vnops.c:225.
The instrumented NetBSD execution panics after the UBSan type-mismatch/null-member-access report, producing a fatal breakpoint in supervisor mode.

failure.operation: Null member access in umap_bypass during VOP_WHITEOUT dispatch

primary_invariant.statement: A VOP_WHITEOUT invocation used to test writable upper-layer whiteout support must provide a non-NULL componentname acceptable to the receiving filesystem implementation.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The pre-fix union_mount call passed a null componentname, and the recorded umap_bypass frame performed member access through that null pointer.

quality.review_notes: The issue record contains an observed UBSan panic and symbolized stack, and the maintainer patch directly replaces the NULL argument. The exact syzbot program, mount/filesystem setup, privileges, pre-fix umap_bypass source line, and a post-fix execution result are absent from usable supplied evidence; the negative oracle is therefore a patch-derived contract, not an observed test result.

remediation.invariant_restored: union_mount passes the address of a static componentname initialized with LOOKUP and NOCRED to VOP_WHITEOUT during the writable upper-layer whiteout-support probe.

target.component: union filesystem whiteout-support probe interacting with umapfs VOP_WHITEOUT handling

oracle.expected_negative: With a valid static LOOKUP/NOCRED componentname passed by union_mount, the cited null-componentname UBSan diagnostic should not occur for the same setup.
oracle.expected_positive: The vulnerable path produces UBSan's member-access-within-null-componentname diagnostic in umap_bypass and the recorded kernel panic.
